### Loading and merging the data

```{python}
# Load data
database_url = os.getenv("DUCKDB_DB_URL")

con = duckdb.connect()
con.execute("INSTALL postgres; LOAD postgres;")  
con.execute(f"ATTACH '{database_url}' AS my_db (TYPE postgres, READ_ONLY);")

dc_df = con.execute("SELECT * FROM my_db.transformed.naics_518_establishments").df()
near_dc_df = con.execute("SELECT * FROM my_db.transformed.naics_518_nearby_estabs_50mi").df()
air_df = con.execute("SELECT * FROM my_db.transformed.air_quality").df()
bus_df = con.execute("SELECT * FROM my_db.transformed.business_patterns").df()
code_df = con.execute("SELECT * FROM my_db.naics_code_look_up").df()
gdp_df = con.execute("SELECT * FROM my_db.transformed.gdp").df()
inc_df = con.execute("SELECT * FROM my_db.transformed.personal_income").df()
pop_df = con.execute("SELECT * FROM my_db.population").df()
perm_df = con.execute("SELECT * FROM my_db.transformed.res_construction_permits").df()
emp_df = con.execute("SELECT * FROM my_db.transformed.unemployment").df()
county_df = con.execute("SELECT * FROM my_db.transformed.us_counties_spatial").df()
```

## Create Table for Regressions

### Create final table

```{python}
bus_county_year_df = dbu.all_county_years(county_df, year_start=2007, year_end=2022)

pivoted_bus_df = mlu.pivot_naics(bus_df, code_df)

final_bus_df = bus_county_year_df[["county_id", "year"]].merge(pivoted_bus_df, on=["county_id", "year"], how="left")

final_bus_df = (
    final_bus_df
    .groupby("county_id", group_keys=False)
    .apply(dbu.impute_all_columns_for_county)
)

final_bus_df = dbu.spatial_then_yoy(final_bus_df, county_df)
```

```{python}
# Create county_year dataframe for merging below
county_year_df = dbu.all_county_years(county_df, year_start=2007, year_end=2022)

county_year_df = county_year_df[["county_id", "year", "land_area_sqmi", "water_area_sqmi"]]

county_year_df["total_area_sqmi"] = county_year_df["land_area_sqmi"] + county_year_df["water_area_sqmi"]
```

```{python}
near_dc_df["nearby_estabs_50mi_landadj"] = near_dc_df["nearby_estabs_50mi_landadj"].round()
```

```{python}
# remove land and water areas from air_df to avoid col name conflict in merge step below
air_df = air_df.drop(columns=["land_area_sqmi", "water_area_sqmi"])

final_df = mlu.combine_dfs(county_year_df, [air_df, final_bus_df, gdp_df, inc_df, pop_df, perm_df, emp_df, dc_df, near_dc_df])
```

### Clean up final table

```{python}
# Make applicable columns per-capita
bus_cols = ["tot_employee_count", "annual_payroll", "tot_establishment_count"]

cols = [c for c in final_df.columns if any(l in c for l in bus_cols)]

per_capita_cols = [
    "real_gdp_2017_dollars_thousands",
    "real_gdp_2017_dollars_thousands_spatial_weighted_avg_5",
    "personal_income_thousands_of_dollars",
    "personal_income_thousands_of_dollars_spatial_weighted_avg_5",
    "all_permits",
    "all_permits_spatial_weighted_avg_5",
    "single_family_permits",
    "single_family_permits_spatial_weighted_avg_5",
    "all_multifamily_permits",
    "all_multifamily_permits_spatial_weighted_avg_5"
] + cols

final_df = mlu.make_per_capita(final_df, per_capita_cols)

final_df["single_family_permits_per_1000"] = (
    final_df["single_family_permits_per_capita"] * 1000
)

final_df["all_multifamily_permits_per_1000"] = (
    final_df["all_multifamily_permits_per_capita"] * 1000
)
```

```{python}
# Per-capita data centers (don't drop original though)
final_df["datacenters_per_capita"] = final_df["estabs"] / final_df["population"]
final_df["datacenters_spatial_per_capita"] = final_df["estabs_spatial_weighted_avg_5"] / final_df["population"]
```

```{python}
# Rename for clarity
```

```{python}
# Add column to county_df which indicates the presence of one or more data centers in a county
```

```{python}
# drop non-numeric columns which are not helpful ids
final_df = final_df.drop(columns=[
    "state_fips_code",

    "county_ns_code",
```

```{python}
# drop features with any missing data
cols_with_high_missingness =  mlu.eda_summary(final_df)[mlu.eda_summary(final_df)["missing_share"] > 0].loc[:,"column"]

cols_with_high_missingness = cols_with_high_missingness.to_list()

final_df = final_df.drop(columns=cols_with_high_missingness)
```

```{python}
# drop features with high skew
skewed_cols =  mlu.eda_summary(final_df)[mlu.eda_summary(final_df)["skew"] > 2].loc[:,"column"]

skewed_cols = skewed_cols.to_list()
if "datacenters" in skewed_cols:
    skewed_cols.remove("datacenters")

final_df = final_df.drop(columns=skewed_cols)
```

### PCA

```{python}
# set up trainning and testing data
cutoff_year = 2018
train_mask = final_df['year'] <= cutoff_year
test_mask = final_df['year'] > cutoff_year

drop_cols = ['has_datacenter', 'datacenters', 'year', 'county_id']

X = final_df.drop(columns=[col for col in drop_cols if col in final_df.columns])
y_binary = final_df['has_datacenter']
y_numeric = final_df['datacenters']

X_train = X.loc[train_mask]
X_test = X.loc[test_mask]

y_train_bin = y_binary.loc[train_mask]
y_test_bin = y_binary.loc[test_mask]

y_train_num = y_numeric.loc[train_mask]
y_test_num = y_numeric.loc[test_mask]

scaler = StandardScaler()
X_train_scaled = scaler.fit_transform(X_train)
X_test_scaled = scaler.transform(X_test)

# cannot use SMOTE on regression, only classification
smote = SMOTE(sampling_strategy='minority', random_state=57)
X_train_bin_sm, y_train_bin_sm = smote.fit_resample(X_train_scaled, y_train_bin)

```

```{python}
pca = PCA(n_components=2)
X_train_pca = pca.fit_transform(X_train_bin_sm)
X_test_pca = pca.transform(X_test_scaled)

model = LogisticRegression()
model.fit(X_train_pca, y_train_bin_sm)

y_pred = model.predict(X_test_pca)
```

```{python}
mlu.model_accuracy_report(model, X_train_pca, y_train_bin_sm, X_test_pca, y_test_bin)
```

```{python}

plt.scatter(
    X_train_pca[:, 0],
    X_train_pca[:, 1],
    c=y_train_sm,
    cmap='coolwarm',
    edgecolor='none',
    s=20,
    alpha=0.1)
plt.xlabel('Principal Component 1')
plt.ylabel('Principal Component 2')
plt.title('After PCA: Projected Training Set')
plt.colorbar(label='Target classes')

plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```

```{python}
pca = PCA(n_components=3)
```

```{python}
df_pca = pd.DataFrame(X_train_pca, columns=['PC1', 'PC2', 'PC3'])
df_pca['target'] = y_train_sm

fig = px.scatter_3d(
    df_pca, 
    x='PC1', y='PC2', z='PC3', 
    color='target',
    opacity=0.5,
    color_continuous_scale='coolwarm',
    title="3D PCA Interactive Plot"
)
fig.update_traces(marker=dict(size=3))
fig.show()
```

### Continous PCA
```{python}
pca = PCA(n_components=2)
X_train_pca = pca.fit_transform(X_train_scaled)
X_test_pca = pca.transform(X_test_scaled)

model_reg = LinearRegression()
model_reg.fit(X_train_pca, y_train_num)

model_reg = LinearRegression()
model_reg.fit(X_train_pca, y_train_num)

y_pred_num = model_reg.predict(X_test_pca)

train_r2 = r2_score(y_train_num, model_reg.predict(X_train_pca))
test_r2 = r2_score(y_test_num, y_pred_num)
test_rmse = np.sqrt(mean_squared_error(y_test_num, y_pred_num))

print(f"Train R²:  {train_r2:.4f}")
print(f"Test R²:   {test_r2:.4f}")
print(f"Test RMSE: {test_rmse:.4f}")
```

```{python}
plt.figure(figsize=(7, 5))
scatter = plt.scatter(
    X_train_pca[:, 0],
    X_train_pca[:, 1],
    c=y_train_num,
    cmap='viridis',
    edgecolors='none',
    s=20,
    alpha=0.3
)
plt.xlabel('Principal Component 1')
plt.ylabel('Principal Component 2')
plt.title('After PCA: Projected Training Set (Linear Regression Target)')
plt.colorbar(scatter, label='Datacenter Count')

plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```

### UMAP

```{python}
# un-supervised

X_train_umap = reducer.fit_transform(X_train_bin_sm)

X_test_umap = reducer.transform(X_test_scaled)

# plot training data
plt.figure(figsize=(7, 5))

    X_train_umap[:, 0], 
    X_train_umap[:, 1], 
    c=y_train_bin_sm, 
    cmap='coolwarm', 
    edgecolor='k', 
    s=80,
    alpha = 0.3
)
plt.xlabel('UMAP Dimension 1')
plt.ylabel('UMAP Dimension 2')
plt.title('UMAP Projection of Training Data')

plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```
